text:
API requests failing with HTTP 502 errors between 14:02 and 14:31 UTC on 2026-08-14.

At 14:02 UTC, a deploy removed the cache warmup step. As a result, 12% of API requests failed with HTTP 502 errors. At 14:27 UTC, the team reverted the deploy. By 14:31 UTC, the error rate returned to normal.

The team is adding a check to the deploy process. This check will make sure that the cache warmup step is present before a deploy can proceed.
